messages.subject: Multi-threaded usage
parts:
Hi guys,

I am wondering how renjin can be used in multi-threaded environment.
If I use it with Akka Actors and execute 10 R scripts in parallel shall (a) I  assume it will run ok and (b) create 10 Engine or share one.

Thanks!

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Multi-threaded usage
parts:
Hi Vladimir,
Yes! Renjin is very much designed to run in a multi-threaded environment. You should start a new Session or ScriptEngine for each thread however, as many packages and base R functions interact with session-level state. Vectors (including data.frame objects for example) can be safely shared between multiple ScriptEngine instances. 

You may also want to exercise more control over Renjin's implicit parallelization: if you may want all sessions to share a common thread pool, or limit each session to a single thread. This can be done by using Renjin's own SessionBuilder, see 
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/cli/src/main/java/org/renjin/cli/Main.java#L146

for an example of providing your own ThreadPool instance.

Let us know how it turns out!

Best,
Alex
